mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, name, description, enabled, record_type, trigger_type, trigger_config, condition_json, actions_json, execution_mode, run_as_user_id, created_by_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.workspace_id, r.name, r.description, r.enabled, r.record_type, r.trigger_type, r.trigger_config, r.condition_json, r.actions_json, r.execution_mode, r.run_as_user_id, r.created_by_id, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM rule r LEFT JOIN workflow w ON w.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND w.legacy_rule_id = r.id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (w.id IS NULL OR w.archived_at IS NULL) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT FROM rule WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rule WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT FROM rule WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rule (workspace_id, name, description, enabled, record_type, trigger_type, trigger_config, condition_json, actions_json, execution_mode, run_as_user_id, created_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{recordType}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerConfig}, #{conditionJson}, #{actionsJson}, #{executionMode}, #{runAsUserId}, #{createdById})
mapper.update: UPDATE rule SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND enabled <> #{enabled}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.workspace_id, r.name, r.description, r.enabled, r.record_type, r.trigger_type, r.trigger_config, r.condition_json, r.actions_json, r.execution_mode, r.run_as_user_id, r.created_by_id, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM rule r LEFT JOIN workflow w ON w.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND w.legacy_rule_id = r.id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.trigger_type = #{triggerType} AND r.enabled = TRUE AND (w.id IS NULL OR ( w.runtime_owner = 'legacy' AND w.archived_at IS NULL AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL )) ORDER BY r.id

SELECT workspace_id FROM ( SELECT r.workspace_id FROM rule r LEFT JOIN workflow w ON w.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND w.legacy_rule_id = r.id WHERE r.trigger_type = 'schedule' AND r.enabled = TRUE AND (w.id IS NULL OR ( w.runtime_owner = 'legacy' AND w.archived_at IS NULL AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL )) UNION SELECT w.workspace_id FROM workflow w JOIN workflow_version v ON v.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND v.workflow_id = w.id AND v.id = w.active_version_id WHERE v.trigger_type = 'schedule' AND w.enabled = TRUE AND w.runtime_owner = 'canonical' AND w.archived_at IS NULL AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL ) scheduled_workspaces ORDER BY workspace_id
SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM rule ORDER BY workspace_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rule_execution (workspace_id, rule_id, trigger_entity_type, trigger_entity_id, status, dedupe_key, detail) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{ruleId}, #{triggerEntityType}, #{triggerEntityId}, #{status}, #{dedupeKey}, #{detail})
mapper.update: UPDATE rule_execution SET status = #{status}, detail = #{detail} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS rule_id, latest_execution.status, latest_execution.executed_at FROM rule r JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT re.status, re.executed_at FROM rule_execution re WHERE re.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND re.rule_id = r.id ORDER BY re.executed_at DESC, re.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_execution ON TRUE WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY r.id
